WITH transaction_averages AS (
  SELECT
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    AVG(sf.shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt,
    AVG(sf.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord AS tr
  JOIN sentimentandfundamentals AS sf
    ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist
),
mix_baselines AS (
  SELECT
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_shortintrt) AS baseline_shortintrt
  FROM transaction_averages
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT
  ta.transreg AS transaction_reference,
  ta.ordertypedist AS order_type_mix,
  ta.avg_shortintrt AS average_short_interest_days_to_cover,
  ta.avg_optvolrt AS average_option_volume_ratio,
  ta.avg_shortintrt / NULLIF(mb.baseline_shortintrt, 0) AS short_interest_to_mix_baseline_ratio
FROM transaction_averages AS ta
JOIN mix_baselines AS mb
  ON ta.ordertypedist = mb.ordertypedist
  OR (ta.ordertypedist IS NULL AND mb.ordertypedist IS NULL)
ORDER BY short_interest_to_mix_baseline_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
